items.docs: Verifies the provided Akismet API key to check its validity and ensure it can be used for API requests.
Checks a comment against the Akismet spam database to determine if it is spam or not.
Submits a comment as spam to Akismet for retraining.
Submits a false positive (legitimate comment marked as spam) to Akismet for training purposes.

info.name: Keep track of the sites that are using your Akismet API key.

params.name: api_key
params.description: The Akismet API key for authorization.

params.name: month
params.description: The month for which you would like to get the report (in `YYYY-MM` format). Defaults to the current month.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter results by site URL or partial site URL.

params.name: format
params.description: The format in which you would like the results to be returned. Allowed values are `json` (default) and `csv`. Defaults to `json`.

params.name: order
params.description: The column by which you would like the results to be sorted. Defaults to `total`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results returned in the report (defaults to 500).

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the results returned in the report (defaults to 0).
